scripts.ui-assets: mkdir -p dist/css dist/font dist/resources && cp ui/index.html start_chromium.sh nudge_pointer.py smart-home.service dist/ && cp -r ui/css/. dist/css/ && cp -r ui/font/. dist/font/ && cp -r ui/resources/. dist/resources/
scripts.ui-dev: npm run ui-assets && xdg-open dist/index.html && npm run ui-build -- --watch
scripts.test: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work --ipc=host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble npx vitest run
scripts.test:update: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work --ipc=host --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble npx vitest run --update
